abstract: BACKGROUND: To find out the effectiveness of color Doppler ultrasonography of the uterine arteries in the differentiation of benign molehydatidiforms from malignant gestational trophoblastic disease. METHODS: Prospective study was performed in 32 women who were referred to the Oncology Department with the diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease. Uterine artery Doppler studies were made and resistance index for both uterine arteries were calculated. In the follow-up, twelve of these patients required chemotherapy (first group) and 20 of them were treated with only suction curettage (second group). Non parametric Mann Whitney U test was used for the statistical analysis. RESULTS: Median of the lowest uterine artery resistance index were 0.29 for the first group and 0.46 for the second group. Resistance index were significantly lower in the first group (alpha<0.001). Color Doppler study of the uterine arteries is helpful in the differentiation of benign molehydatiforms from malignant gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 背景：良性胞状奇胎と悪性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)を鑑別するうえでの子宮動脈カラードプラ超音波検査の有用性を明らかにすること。方法：腫瘍科に妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断で紹介された32例の女性を対象とした前向き研究を行った。子宮動脈のドプラ検査を施行し、両側子宮動脈の抵抗係数を算出した。フォローアップの過程で、12例は化学療法を必要とし(第1群)、20例は吸引搔爬術のみで治療された(第2群)。統計解析にはノンパラメトリックのMann-Whitney U検定を用いた。結果：子宮動脈の最低抵抗係数の中央値は、第1群で0.29、第2群で0.46であった。抵抗係数は第1群で有意に低かった(α<0.001)。結論：子宮動脈のカラードプラ検査は、良性胞状奇胎と悪性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の鑑別に有用である。
